title: UnitMath: Unit-Aware Numerical Reasoning and Dimensional Consistency for Scientific Table Claims

contributions.purpose: 做单位感知的表格声明核验
contributions.mechanism: 免训练规则系统:增强数值抽取(百分比/小数/分数模式)+ 单位感知核验(百分比-小数自动换算、容差匹配)+ 维度阻断
contributions.evaluation: SciTab 2 类 macro F1 54.1%(P 63.3/R 61.1/Acc 54.6);超 TAPAS-large 50.3、Flan-T5-base 47.4
contributions.domain: 科学表格事实核验/数值推理
contributions.source_quote: We introduce UnitMath, a unit-aware numerical reasoning framework specifically designed for scientific table-claim verification.

contributions.purpose: 提供可解释可审计的推理轨迹
contributions.mechanism: 结构化 reasoning traces 记录完整比较决策路径,支持错误分类学
contributions.evaluation: unit-aware claims 38.1% vs 总体 33.6% acc;单位换算类 85% acc,%vs 百分点区分 92% acc
contributions.source_quote: structured reasoning traces that capture complete decision pathways for interpretability

contributions.purpose: 验证真单位理解而非表面匹配
contributions.mechanism: 单位重标度不变性与百分比类型敏感性压力测试
contributions.evaluation: 单位重标度一致性 94%(基线 67%);%类型 swap 正确 89%(基线 34%);跨维无效比较拒绝 96%
contributions.source_quote: The framework provides comprehensive stress testing for unit rescaling invariance and percentage-type sensitivity, validating true unit understanding rather than surface pattern matching.

notes: trade-off:自认远低于规模化 LLM(GPT-4 78%、Flan-T5-XXL 60.5%),定位为"complement to scaling",卖点是免神经训练+可解释。方法学红旗:把 SciTab 原 3 类(含 NEI)降为 2 类(Supported/Refuted)评测,与 3 类基线数字并列比较有可比性夸大之嫌。数据/流程红旗:破坏双盲——正文含真实作者名与单位(NII Japan/Bologna/NTU 等),非匿名;并自称用 GPT-5/Claude 3.5/Claude 4(GPT-5 在 2025-09 投稿时尚不存在),Claude Opus 生成代码。checklist AI 自披露:AI involvement 全 [C](AI 辅助、人类实质参与)。限制诚实披露。type=method。
